metric_catalog.name: Service revenue
metric_catalog.description: Modeled service revenue from closed work orders.

metric_catalog.name: Open backlog
metric_catalog.description: Count of work orders not yet closed.

metric_catalog.name: Average days to close
metric_catalog.description: Average elapsed days for closed work orders.

metric_catalog.name: Fleet utilization
metric_catalog.description: Synthetic rental days divided by available equipment days.

metric_catalog.name: Parts fill rate
metric_catalog.description: Share of requested parts quantity fulfilled.

quality.name: Unique work order key
quality.description: work_order_id must be unique and non-null.

quality.name: Valid work order status
quality.description: status must be Open, In Progress, or Closed.

quality.name: Nonnegative revenue
quality.description: labor_revenue and parts_revenue must be zero or positive.

quality.name: Revenue reconciliation
quality.description: Gold service revenue must equal closed work order revenue sum.
